title: Simple Flares
description: Adds throwable small and sticky large flares for cave exploration.
body:
### **Simple Flares**

Simple Flares is a mod that creates temporary light sources (flares), making it perfect for cave explorers who want to light up deep chasms without spamming torches everywhere.

### **Small Flare:**

![small flare](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1be69c377651aaf3f1a88494751a2eb4f16ffd5.png)
> - Behavior: Bouncy. It bounces off walls and solid blocks.
> - Lifespan: Burns for 25 seconds.
> - Light level: 12.
> - 1 Stick + 1 Gunpowder = 2 Small Flares

![craft small flare](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3c8f4a4f55a7bffa01dd8753f6d759bcc341eef.png)





### **Large Flare:**

![Large_flare](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9d101da660d9474354b95ed7d4b446a92f09207.png)
> - Behavior: Sticky. It automatically sticks to any wall or ceiling it hits—perfect for lighting up giant ravines from above or from the sides.
> - Lifespan: burns for 1 minute.
> - Light level: 15.
> - 1 Stick + 1 Slimeball + 1 Glowstone Dust + 2 Paper = 2 Large Flaers

![craft large flare](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/095a416f213d6822b4bf85fb63fdd9f451d1dced.png)
